what: Once on hover over a text button like ‹view more› (.8s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1)) — the text line slides up and out (49%) and rises back in from below, the side arrow exits to the right and re-enters from the left, and the underline shrinks to the right end and is redrawn from the left. It finishes after .8s even if the pointer stays, and re-hovering within that time does not restart it (one up-and-down ride, like an elevator)
note: Arrow and underline children are optional. Not applied on touch screens (the original also only at 768px and above)

from.where: All pages view more·Contact·menu links (original .js-hover-elevator — is-hover 800ms, ahButtonText·ahButtonArrow·expansionAndContraction .8s cubic-bezier(.165,.84,.44,1))
